name: Apprentice Employee Assistance Program (free counselling)
summary: Free, confidential short-term counselling for apprentices and trainees employed by Victorian businesses, delivered by Converge.
key: Up to four free short-term counselling sessions for each issue.
who: Apprentices and trainees employed by Victorian businesses
how: Call Converge on 1300 687 327 and use organisation code APPRENTV, or book through the Converge website or app.

source.label: Apprenticeships Victoria: Apprentice Employee Assistance Program

evidence.quote: All apprentices and trainees employed by Victorian businesses can use the program.
up to four short-term counselling sessions for each issue you are experiencing
